meta.title: Trapped Gambit
meta.description: A masterful hunter often takes the guise of the prey.

units.rawText: We've been following the locator signal into the depths of Tartarus.
units.displayText: We've been following the locator signal into the depths of Tartarus.

spans.text: We've been following the locator signal into the depths of Tartarus.

units.rawText: The signal origin is moving west. Where is she going?
units.displayText: The signal origin is moving west. Where is she going?

spans.text: The signal origin is moving west. Where is she going?

units.rawText: (Groans) Owie...
units.displayText: (Groans) Owie...

spans.text: (Groans) Owie...

units.rawText: Demiurge is still unconscious in my arms. She grimaces and moans from time to time, tightening her little tentacles around me.
units.displayText: Demiurge is still unconscious in my arms. She grimaces and moans from time to time, tightening her little tentacles around me.

spans.text: Demiurge is still unconscious in my arms. She grimaces and moans from time to time, tightening her little tentacles around me.

units.rawText: I managed to do some simple first aid before this, but she still has more severe burn and slash wounds that haven't been properly treated yet.
units.displayText: I managed to do some simple first aid before this, but she still has more severe burn and slash wounds that haven't been properly treated yet.

spans.text: I managed to do some simple first aid before this, but she still has more severe burn and slash wounds that haven't been properly treated yet.

units.rawText: Until we find Sol, we need to give Demi more advanced medical care.
units.displayText: Until we find Sol, we need to give Demi more advanced medical care.

spans.text: Until we find Sol, we need to give Demi more advanced medical care.

units.rawText: The Middle Ring Watchtowers have repair bays, which is where Sol was headed. We can head over there.
units.displayText: The Middle Ring Watchtowers have repair bays, which is where Sol was headed. We can head over there.

spans.text: The Middle Ring Watchtowers have repair bays, which is where Sol was headed. We can head over there.

units.rawText: I point to the nearby Watchtower by way of emphasis. During the previous Sanctifier infiltration mission, Electra was hurt and Alcyone guarded one while waiting for the Halos in the other Watchtowers to be activated.
units.displayText: I point to the nearby Watchtower by way of emphasis. During the previous Sanctifier infiltration mission, Electra was hurt and Alcyone guarded one while waiting for the Halos in the other Watchtowers to be activated.

spans.text: I point to the nearby Watchtower by way of emphasis. During the previous Sanctifier infiltration mission, Electra was hurt and Alcyone guarded one while waiting for the Halos in the other Watchtowers to be activated.

units.rawText: But as it turned out, the Sanctifiers' destiny would once again be overwritten by their commands once the Halo system was fully activated, resulting in tragedy.
units.displayText: But as it turned out, the Sanctifiers' destiny would once again be overwritten by their commands once the Halo system was fully activated, resulting in tragedy.

units.rawText: Yup! Let me think of a way to ease her pain for now... Urk!
units.displayText: Yup! Let me think of a way to ease her pain for now... Urk!

spans.text: Yup! Let me think of a way to ease her pain for now... Urk!

units.rawText: Rumble—the towering walls around us sink into the ground, and the flat path we're walking on suddenly lurches upward as the labyrinth begins shifting.
units.displayText: Rumble—the towering walls around us sink into the ground, and the flat path we're walking on suddenly lurches upward as the labyrinth begins shifting.

spans.text: Rumble—the towering walls around us sink into the ground, and the flat path we're walking on suddenly lurches upward as the labyrinth begins shifting.

units.rawText: Persicaria helps me keep my balance and glances toward the Map out of the corner of her eye.
units.displayText: Persicaria helps me keep my balance and glances toward the Map out of the corner of her eye.

spans.text: Persicaria helps me keep my balance and glances toward the Map out of the corner of her eye.

units.rawText: The Watchtower's position has shifted... Wait a minute! Sol...
units.displayText: The Watchtower's position has shifted... Wait a minute! Sol...

spans.text: The Watchtower's position has shifted... Wait a minute! Sol...

units.rawText: What's wrong?
units.displayText: What's wrong?

spans.text: What's wrong?

units.rawText: I follow her gaze to where she's looking on the Map.
units.displayText: I follow her gaze to where she's looking on the Map.

spans.text: I follow her gaze to where she's looking on the Map.

units.rawText: The bouncing points of light on the Map have stopped moving, but Sol's locator signal is gone.
units.displayText: The bouncing points of light on the Map have stopped moving, but Sol's locator signal is gone.

spans.text: The bouncing points of light on the Map have stopped moving, but Sol's locator signal is gone.

units.rawText: The Entropic hordes around the Watchtower are sleeping soundly, though one or two of them look up upon sensing something unusual.
units.displayText: The Entropic hordes around the Watchtower are sleeping soundly, though one or two of them look up upon sensing something unusual.

spans.text: The Entropic hordes around the Watchtower are sleeping soundly, though one or two of them look up upon sensing something unusual.

units.rawText: Persicaria holds Demiurge in one hand while dispatching these scattered Entropics with her other, then turns to head into the repair bay within the Watchtower.
units.displayText: Persicaria holds Demiurge in one hand while dispatching these scattered Entropics with her other, then turns to head into the repair bay within the Watchtower.

spans.text: Persicaria holds Demiurge in one hand while dispatching these scattered Entropics with her other, then turns to head into the repair bay within the Watchtower.

units.rawText: Tap, tap—As she treads over the old ruins and enters the room, she is assailed by the scent of rot and decay. There are a bunch of devices messily piled up in the repair bay. Persicaria puts Demiurge down before rummaging through them.
units.displayText: Tap, tap—As she treads over the old ruins and enters the room, she is assailed by the scent of rot and decay. There are a bunch of devices messily piled up in the repair bay. Persicaria puts Demiurge down before rummaging through them.

units.rawText: This is good, we can still use the repair equipment here...
units.displayText: This is good, we can still use the repair equipment here...

spans.text: This is good, we can still use the repair equipment here...

units.rawText: But this was originally a Sanctifier Watchtower, I wonder if there are any repair ports we can use for a juvenile Entropic...
units.displayText: But this was originally a Sanctifier Watchtower, I wonder if there are any repair ports we can use for a juvenile Entropic...

spans.text: But this was originally a Sanctifier Watchtower, I wonder if there are any repair ports we can use for a juvenile Entropic...

units.displayText: I wonder if a connector cable for Lesser Sanctifiers would work?

spans.text: I wonder if a connector cable for Lesser Sanctifiers would work?

units.rawText: Looking for this?
units.displayText: Looking for this?

spans.text: Looking for this?

units.rawText: An ethereal voice echoes in the cramped, dark room. A hand suddenly comes into view, holding a connector that matches Demiurge.
units.displayText: An ethereal voice echoes in the cramped, dark room. A hand suddenly comes into view, holding a connector that matches Demiurge.

spans.text: An ethereal voice echoes in the cramped, dark room. A hand suddenly comes into view, holding a connector that matches Demiurge.

units.rawText: ...Thank you.
units.displayText: ...Thank you.

spans.text: ...Thank you.

units.rawText: You're welcome.
units.displayText: You're welcome.

spans.text: You're welcome.

units.rawText: Persicaria hesitates briefly before taking the cable and connecting Demiurge's neural cloud to the repair device.
units.displayText: Persicaria hesitates briefly before taking the cable and connecting Demiurge's neural cloud to the repair device.

spans.text: Persicaria hesitates briefly before taking the cable and connecting Demiurge's neural cloud to the repair device.

units.rawText: After ensuring that it's running normally, Persicaria sighs in relief and turns to face the other person.
units.displayText: After ensuring that it's running normally, Persicaria sighs in relief and turns to face the other person.

spans.text: After ensuring that it's running normally, Persicaria sighs in relief and turns to face the other person.

units.rawText: Thank...
units.displayText: Thank...

spans.text: Thank...

units.rawText: Before she can finish, her opponent steps in at lightning speed. An arc of crimson flames speeds in at her face; Persicaria leaps back quickly to open up the distance and draws the blade at her waist without hesitation, as though she was expecting this.
units.displayText: Before she can finish, her opponent steps in at lightning speed. An arc of crimson flames speeds in at her face; Persicaria leaps back quickly to open up the distance and draws the blade at her waist without hesitation, as though she was expecting this.

spans.text: Before she can finish, her opponent steps in at lightning speed. An arc of crimson flames speeds in at her face; Persicaria leaps back quickly to open up the distance and draws the blade at her waist without hesitation, as though she was expecting this.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: Their blades clash and bind tightly; neither party is willing to back off. They stare past their respective weapons into each other's eyes.
units.displayText: Their blades clash and bind tightly; neither party is willing to back off. They stare past their respective weapons into each other's eyes.

spans.text: Their blades clash and bind tightly; neither party is willing to back off. They stare past their respective weapons into each other's eyes.

units.rawText: And here I thought you'd had a change of heart, Sol.
units.displayText: And here I thought you'd had a change of heart, Sol.

spans.text: And here I thought you'd had a change of heart, Sol.

units.rawText: I simply wanted one of my injured kin to receive treatment.
units.displayText: I simply wanted one of my injured kin to receive treatment.

spans.text: I simply wanted one of my injured kin to receive treatment.

units.rawText: Still, given your reaction, it looks like you already guessed that I'd be here.
units.displayText: Still, given your reaction, it looks like you already guessed that I'd be here.

spans.text: Still, given your reaction, it looks like you already guessed that I'd be here.

units.rawText: ...I wasn't sure, but I decided to bet on it.
units.displayText: ...I wasn't sure, but I decided to bet on it.

spans.text: ...I wasn't sure, but I decided to bet on it.

units.rawText: Bet on what?
units.displayText: Bet on what?

spans.text: Bet on what?

units.rawText: That you'd be as stubborn as ever.
units.displayText: That you'd be as stubborn as ever.

spans.text: That you'd be as stubborn as ever.

units.rawText: A faint tremor comes through the deadlocked blades. Persicaria isn't sure how much longer she can hold out and gathers an operand blast to force Sol back.
units.displayText: A faint tremor comes through the deadlocked blades. Persicaria isn't sure how much longer she can hold out and gathers an operand blast to force Sol back.

spans.text: A faint tremor comes through the deadlocked blades. Persicaria isn't sure how much longer she can hold out and gathers an operand blast to force Sol back.

units.rawText: Hng!
units.displayText: Hng!

spans.text: Hng!

units.rawText: Sol takes a couple of steps back. In her eyes, Persicaria is having a hard time just blocking her attacks, but she's still talking good game.
units.displayText: Sol takes a couple of steps back. In her eyes, Persicaria is having a hard time just blocking her attacks, but she's still talking good game.

spans.text: Sol takes a couple of steps back. In her eyes, Persicaria is having a hard time just blocking her attacks, but she's still talking good game.

units.rawText: (Pants) You should just give up.
units.displayText: (Pants) You should just give up.

spans.text: (Pants) You should just give up.

units.rawText: Sure, you won your bet. But so what? It's not like you can beat me.
units.displayText: Sure, you won your bet. But so what? It's not like you can beat me.

spans.text: Sure, you won your bet. But so what? It's not like you can beat me.

units.rawText: Then, as though to back up her own retort, Sol brings her sword down in a mighty cleaving strike that tears through the air with a sickeningly sweet whistle.
units.displayText: Then, as though to back up her own retort, Sol brings her sword down in a mighty cleaving strike that tears through the air with a sickeningly sweet whistle.

spans.text: Then, as though to back up her own retort, Sol brings her sword down in a mighty cleaving strike that tears through the air with a sickeningly sweet whistle.

units.rawText: Worried that Demiurge will be caught up in the fighting, Persicaria has no choice but to shift toward the corner of the room, but her footing is unsteady after several dodges. Sol seizes the opportunity to stab at her left arm.
units.displayText: Worried that Demiurge will be caught up in the fighting, Persicaria has no choice but to shift toward the corner of the room, but her footing is unsteady after several dodges. Sol seizes the opportunity to stab at her left arm.

spans.text: Worried that Demiurge will be caught up in the fighting, Persicaria has no choice but to shift toward the corner of the room, but her footing is unsteady after several dodges. Sol seizes the opportunity to stab at her left arm.

units.rawText: Ngh!
units.displayText: Ngh!

spans.text: Ngh!

units.rawText: Persicaria grunts in pain. Sol turns her blade to strike at Persicaria's core. The pink-haired Doll cannot sidestep it in time and clumsily rolls aside.
units.displayText: Persicaria grunts in pain. Sol turns her blade to strike at Persicaria's core. The pink-haired Doll cannot sidestep it in time and clumsily rolls aside.

spans.text: Persicaria grunts in pain. Sol turns her blade to strike at Persicaria's core. The pink-haired Doll cannot sidestep it in time and clumsily rolls aside.

units.rawText: The constant whistling of Sol's blade slicing through the air fills her ears. It throws off a spray of sparks as it hits the ground, each time barely missing Persicaria by a hair's breadth.
units.displayText: The constant whistling of Sol's blade slicing through the air fills her ears. It throws off a spray of sparks as it hits the ground, each time barely missing Persicaria by a hair's breadth.

spans.text: The constant whistling of Sol's blade slicing through the air fills her ears. It throws off a spray of sparks as it hits the ground, each time barely missing Persicaria by a hair's breadth.

units.rawText: Warning! Left arm damaged. Range of motion decreased by 12%. Immediate medical attention advised.
units.displayText: Warning! Left arm damaged. Range of motion decreased by 12%. Immediate medical attention advised.

spans.text: Warning! Left arm damaged. Range of motion decreased by 12%. Immediate medical attention advised.

units.rawText: (I can't let this go on. Even if I can read Sol's movements, I can't match her in strength.)
units.displayText: I can't let this go on. Even if I can read Sol's movements, I can't match her in strength.

spans.text: I can't let this go on. Even if I can read Sol's movements, I can't match her in strength.

units.rawText: Upon realizing her physical disadvantage, Persicaria grits her teeth and steadies her body with one hand before lashing out with a sweep from her right leg.
units.displayText: Upon realizing her physical disadvantage, Persicaria grits her teeth and steadies her body with one hand before lashing out with a sweep from her right leg.

spans.text: Upon realizing her physical disadvantage, Persicaria grits her teeth and steadies her body with one hand before lashing out with a sweep from her right leg.

units.rawText: Be it dexterity, strength, or speed... you are at a disadvantage in every field.
units.displayText: Be it dexterity, strength, or speed... you are at a disadvantage in every field.

spans.text: Be it dexterity, strength, or speed... you are at a disadvantage in every field.

units.rawText: Your moves are more powerful and ruthless than before. It's been a little over an hour; have you already figured yourself out in that short time?
units.displayText: Your moves are more powerful and ruthless than before. It's been a little over an hour; have you already figured yourself out in that short time?

spans.text: Your moves are more powerful and ruthless than before. It's been a little over an hour; have you already figured yourself out in that short time?

units.rawText: I hate how you think you have all the answers, how you keep trying to draw conclusions about me based on what you know about someone else.
units.displayText: I hate how you think you have all the answers, how you keep trying to draw conclusions about me based on what you know about someone else.

spans.text: I hate how you think you have all the answers, how you keep trying to draw conclusions about me based on what you know about someone else.

units.rawText: Your arrogance has made you overestimate your strength and underestimate my determination to destroy you.
units.displayText: Your arrogance has made you overestimate your strength and underestimate my determination to destroy you.

spans.text: Your arrogance has made you overestimate your strength and underestimate my determination to destroy you.

units.rawText: I will not allow you to slaughter my kin. In keeping with Lady Malkira's orders, I will exterminate you intruders, who attempt to disorient my neural cloud.
units.displayText: I will not allow you to slaughter my kin. In keeping with Lady Malkira's orders, I will exterminate you intruders, who attempt to disorient my neural cloud.

spans.text: I will not allow you to slaughter my kin. In keeping with Lady Malkira's orders, I will exterminate you intruders, who attempt to disorient my neural cloud.

units.rawText: Sol's longsword stabs straight at Persicaria. However, what disturbs her is the fact that there is no panic on her opponent's face, only her usual calm.
units.displayText: Sol's longsword stabs straight at Persicaria. However, what disturbs her is the fact that there is no panic on her opponent's face, only her usual calm.

spans.text: Sol's longsword stabs straight at Persicaria. However, what disturbs her is the fact that there is no panic on her opponent's face, only her usual calm.

units.rawText: I knew from the start that your fighting strength was on a different level from mine. I would be at a disadvantage the longer I drew out the battle, but I still insisted on fighting you.
units.displayText: I knew from the start that your fighting strength was on a different level from mine. I would be at a disadvantage the longer I drew out the battle, but I still insisted on fighting you.

spans.text: I knew from the start that your fighting strength was on a different level from mine. I would be at a disadvantage the longer I drew out the battle, but I still insisted on fighting you.

units.rawText: That is because our previous battle was just between the two of us...
units.displayText: That is because our previous battle was just between the two of us...

spans.text: That is because our previous battle was just between the two of us...

units.rawText: But right now... I'm not the only one you're fighting!
units.displayText: But right now... I'm not the only one you're fighting!

spans.text: But right now... I'm not the only one you're fighting!

units.rawText: Just as she says that, the crisp voice of a system announcement fills the Watchtower's interior.
units.displayText: Just as she says that, the crisp voice of a system announcement fills the Watchtower's interior.

spans.text: Just as she says that, the crisp voice of a system announcement fills the Watchtower's interior.

units.rawText: Command confirmed. Requester is <cmdr>. Access confirmed. Activating Halo system in objectTower_b2. Now blocking data...
units.displayText: Command confirmed. Requester is {교수}. Access confirmed. Activating Halo system in objectTower_b2. Now blocking data...

spans.text: Command confirmed. Requester is
. Access confirmed. Activating Halo system in objectTower_b2. Now blocking data...

units.rawText: As the mechanical voice rattles off announcement after announcement, waves of purifying light emanate from the core of the Watchtower, shredding the purple Sector around it with sacred radiance.
units.displayText: As the mechanical voice rattles off announcement after announcement, waves of purifying light emanate from the core of the Watchtower, shredding the purple Sector around it with sacred radiance.

spans.text: As the mechanical voice rattles off announcement after announcement, waves of purifying light emanate from the core of the Watchtower, shredding the purple Sector around it with sacred radiance.

units.rawText: Hsss—
units.displayText: Hsss—

spans.text: Hsss—

units.rawText: The surrounding Low Order Entropics hiss in agony, their bodies contorting, melting and ultimately disintegrate into motes of operands that vanish into the air.
units.displayText: The surrounding Low Order Entropics hiss in agony, their bodies contorting, melting and ultimately disintegrate into motes of operands that vanish into the air.

spans.text: The surrounding Low Order Entropics hiss in agony, their bodies contorting, melting and ultimately disintegrate into motes of operands that vanish into the air.

units.rawText: Dammit... My kin...
units.displayText: Dammit... My kin...

spans.text: Dammit... My kin...

units.rawText: What... What did you do...
units.displayText: What... What did you do...

spans.text: What... What did you do...

units.rawText: Sol is forced to her knees beneath the crushing power of the Halo. She hoarsely manages to squeeze out a few words as the flames on her weapon's edge flicker in and out of existence, like a candle in the wind.
units.displayText: Sol is forced to her knees beneath the crushing power of the Halo. She hoarsely manages to squeeze out a few words as the flames on her weapon's edge flicker in and out of existence, like a candle in the wind.

spans.text: Sol is forced to her knees beneath the crushing power of the Halo. She hoarsely manages to squeeze out a few words as the flames on her weapon's edge flicker in and out of existence, like a candle in the wind.

units.rawText: She tries to struggle to her feet, but even moving is difficult. It is as though she has been sapped of all her strength.
units.displayText: She tries to struggle to her feet, but even moving is difficult. It is as though she has been sapped of all her strength.

spans.text: She tries to struggle to her feet, but even moving is difficult. It is as though she has been sapped of all her strength.

units.rawText: Using such... despicable tactics...
units.displayText: Using such... despicable tactics...

spans.text: Using such... despicable tactics...

units.rawText: Persicaria continues looking down on Sol. After closing her eyes for a moment, her reluctance fades from her eyes and she tightens her grip on her sword once again.
units.displayText: Persicaria continues looking down on Sol. After closing her eyes for a moment, her reluctance fades from her eyes and she tightens her grip on her sword once again.

spans.text: Persicaria continues looking down on Sol. After closing her eyes for a moment, her reluctance fades from her eyes and she tightens her grip on her sword once again.

units.rawText: ...That's right. This was a trap laid just for you.
units.displayText: ...That's right. This was a trap laid just for you.

spans.text: ...That's right. This was a trap laid just for you.

units.rawText: Not long ago...
units.displayText: Not long ago...

spans.text: Not long ago...

units.rawText: Sol's locator signal has vanished.
units.displayText: Sol's locator signal has vanished.

spans.text: Sol's locator signal has vanished.

units.rawText: Looks like she found the tracker. I thought she'd take a little longer to do it; then we'd be able to find Malkira along with her.
units.displayText: Looks like she found the tracker. I thought she'd take a little longer to do it; then we'd be able to find Malkira along with her.

spans.text: Looks like she found the tracker. I thought she'd take a little longer to do it; then we'd be able to find Malkira along with her.

units.rawText: Looks like we'll have to think of something else.
units.displayText: Looks like we'll have to think of something else.

spans.text: Looks like we'll have to think of something else.

units.rawText: She's not the person who will sit there and wait for things to happen to her. After knowing that we intruders are still in Tartarus, the thought of driving us out will always be on her mind.
units.displayText: She's not the person who will sit there and wait for things to happen to her. After knowing that we intruders are still in Tartarus, the thought of driving us out will always be on her mind.

spans.text: She's not the person who will sit there and wait for things to happen to her. After knowing that we intruders are still in Tartarus, the thought of driving us out will always be on her mind.

units.rawText: Persicaria reaches for the bottle at her chest.
units.displayText: Persicaria reaches for the bottle at her chest.

spans.text: Persicaria reaches for the bottle at her chest.

units.rawText: After all, during the defense of the Oasis, she didn't flinch even when she was going up against Eosphorus.
units.displayText: After all, during the defense of the Oasis, she didn't flinch even when she was going up against Eosphorus.

spans.text: After all, during the defense of the Oasis, she didn't flinch even when she was going up against Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Sol must be lying in ambush somewhere, waiting for a chance to make her move. Once she heals up, she'll launch an attack.
units.displayText: Sol must be lying in ambush somewhere, waiting for a chance to make her move. Once she heals up, she'll launch an attack.

spans.text: Sol must be lying in ambush somewhere, waiting for a chance to make her move. Once she heals up, she'll launch an attack.

units.displayText: If that's the case, then we won't need to go out of our way to chase down Sol.

spans.text: If that's the case, then we won't need to go out of our way to chase down Sol.

units.rawText: Don't forget that we're here to meet with Malkira. Whether we end up talking or fighting, we need to do everything we can to ease the pressure on the frontlines.

units.displayText: After being Entropized, Sol has become more powerful. If we end up meeting her again, we'll have a hard time escaping in one piece.

units.rawText: Actually, I have an idea.

units.displayText: I point to a mote of light on the Rubik's Map.

units.displayText: The humans installed a Halo system in Tartarus' Watchtowers. Activating it will greatly weaken Entropics within its area of effect.

spans.text: The next labyrinth shift will create a direct path to the Watchtower. It'll end up taking us right to Sol.

units.rawText: Given her straightforward nature, she'll most likely be waiting there to ambush us. After arriving at the Watchtower, we...
units.displayText: Given her straightforward nature, she'll most likely be waiting there to ambush us. After arriving at the Watchtower, we...

spans.text: Given her straightforward nature, she'll most likely be waiting there to ambush us. After arriving at the Watchtower, we...

units.rawText: So you were lying in wait.
units.displayText: So you were lying in wait.

spans.text: So you were lying in wait.

units.rawText: Well, that was all because of you. All we could do was work around that.
units.displayText: Well, that was all because of you. All we could do was work around that.

spans.text: Well, that was all because of you. All we could do was work around that.

units.rawText: Persicaria wobbles and she bites back her pain as she picks up the sword on the ground.
units.displayText: Persicaria wobbles and she bites back her pain as she picks up the sword on the ground.

spans.text: Persicaria wobbles and she bites back her pain as she picks up the sword on the ground.

units.rawText: ...You think you can beat me just because I've been weakened?
units.displayText: ...You think you can beat me just because I've been weakened?

spans.text: ...You think you can beat me just because I've been weakened?

units.rawText: You're badly hurt, and your friend... Well, I don't think they can fight at all, can they?
units.displayText: You're badly hurt, and your friend... Well, I don't think they can fight at all, can they?

spans.text: You're badly hurt, and your friend... Well, I don't think they can fight at all, can they?

units.rawText: No.
units.displayText: No.

spans.text: No.

units.rawText: You might laugh at my answer now, but your past self would have agreed with me 100%.
units.displayText: You might laugh at my answer now, but your past self would have agreed with me 100%.

spans.text: You might laugh at my answer now, but your past self would have agreed with me 100%.

units.rawText: I believe in my friends at all times...
units.displayText: I believe in my friends at all times...

spans.text: I believe in my friends at all times...

units.rawText: <size=40>And I believe in the Professor!</size>
units.displayText: And I believe in the Professor!

spans.text: And I believe in the Professor!

units.rawText: ...We'll split up. I'll go activate the Halo and the sentry guns. You take Demiurge to the Watchtower's repair bay for healing.
units.displayText: ...We'll split up. I'll go activate the Halo and the sentry guns. You take Demiurge to the Watchtower's repair bay for healing.

spans.text: ...We'll split up. I'll go activate the Halo and the sentry guns. You take Demiurge to the Watchtower's repair bay for healing.

units.rawText: And leave you alone?
units.displayText: And leave you alone?

spans.text: And leave you alone?

units.rawText: I can't allow that, if anything happens to you...
units.displayText: I can't allow that, if anything happens to you...

spans.text: I can't allow that, if anything happens to you...

units.rawText: Persicaria's eyes are filled with worry and she starts to panic.
units.displayText: Persicaria's eyes are filled with worry and she starts to panic.

spans.text: Persicaria's eyes are filled with worry and she starts to panic.

units.rawText: Listen to me, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Listen to me, Persicaria.

spans.text: Listen to me, Persicaria.

units.rawText: I lightly place my hand on her shoulder to try and calm her down.
units.displayText: I lightly place my hand on her shoulder to try and calm her down.

spans.text: I lightly place my hand on her shoulder to try and calm her down.

units.rawText: This is a bet. We're betting that Sol will show up and ambush us inside the Watchtower. We're also betting that the forces we can muster will even the score with Sol.
units.displayText: This is a bet. We're betting that Sol will show up and ambush us inside the Watchtower. We're also betting that the forces we can muster will even the score with Sol.

spans.text: This is a bet. We're betting that Sol will show up and ambush us inside the Watchtower. We're also betting that the forces we can muster will even the score with Sol.

units.rawText: For that, the Halo, the sentry guns, and you—Persicaria—are all essential.
units.displayText: For that, the Halo, the sentry guns, and you—Persicaria—are all essential.

spans.text: For that, the Halo, the sentry guns, and you—Persicaria—are all essential.

units.rawText: We're going to put our chips on the table now. You've entrusted everything to me, so I'm going to make the most of it.
units.displayText: We're going to put our chips on the table now. You've entrusted everything to me, so I'm going to make the most of it.

spans.text: We're going to put our chips on the table now. You've entrusted everything to me, so I'm going to make the most of it.

units.rawText: So please, believe in me.
units.displayText: So please, believe in me.

spans.text: So please, believe in me.

units.rawText: I see... Haha...
units.displayText: I see... Haha...

spans.text: I see... Haha...

units.rawText: <size=40>Haha... Ahahaha! Good!</size>
units.displayText: Haha... Ahahaha! Good!

spans.text: Haha... Ahahaha! Good!

units.rawText: From her kneeling position, Sol plunges her sword into the ground. The Halo system is running at full power, and the flames on her sword are nearly extinguished.
units.displayText: From her kneeling position, Sol plunges her sword into the ground. The Halo system is running at full power, and the flames on her sword are nearly extinguished.

spans.text: From her kneeling position, Sol plunges her sword into the ground. The Halo system is running at full power, and the flames on her sword are nearly extinguished.

units.rawText: Sol, I don't want to fight you, so...
units.displayText: Sol, I don't want to fight you, so...

spans.text: Sol, I don't want to fight you, so...

units.rawText: Spare me that nonsense. You can't shake my will with just a few words.
units.displayText: Spare me that nonsense. You can't shake my will with just a few words.

spans.text: Spare me that nonsense. You can't shake my will with just a few words.

units.rawText: Cracks spread out along the ground, radiating from her sword. The wounds on Sol's hand tear open and blood drips down its edge.
units.displayText: Cracks spread out along the ground, radiating from her sword. The wounds on Sol's hand tear open and blood drips down its edge.

spans.text: Cracks spread out along the ground, radiating from her sword. The wounds on Sol's hand tear open and blood drips down its edge.

units.rawText: And right after that, flames race down the blood trail and ignite!
units.displayText: And right after that, flames race down the blood trail and ignite!

spans.text: And right after that, flames race down the blood trail and ignite!

units.rawText: You talk about friends, trust, the past, and you use them as your reasons to fight...
units.displayText: You talk about friends, trust, the past, and you use them as your reasons to fight...

spans.text: You talk about friends, trust, the past, and you use them as your reasons to fight...

units.rawText: Every word Sol says makes the stake in her chest glow just a little bit brighter.
units.displayText: Every word Sol says makes the stake in her chest glow just a little bit brighter.

spans.text: Every word Sol says makes the stake in her chest glow just a little bit brighter.

units.rawText: <size=40>But even if I have none of that, I still have my own convictions!</size>
units.displayText: But even if I have none of that, I still have my own convictions!

spans.text: But even if I have none of that, I still have my own convictions!

units.rawText: <size=40>HAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!</size>
units.displayText: HAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!

spans.text: HAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!

units.rawText: Sol yells at the top of her voice and stands back up despite the immense pain it's causing her. Her weapon rises with her, the leaping flames around it trailing around like the grim reaper.
units.displayText: Sol yells at the top of her voice and stands back up despite the immense pain it's causing her. Her weapon rises with her, the leaping flames around it trailing around like the grim reaper.

spans.text: Sol yells at the top of her voice and stands back up despite the immense pain it's causing her. Her weapon rises with her, the leaping flames around it trailing around like the grim reaper.

units.rawText: Sentry guns, fire—
units.displayText: Sentry guns, fire—

spans.text: Sentry guns, fire—

units.rawText: Dazzling white beams spray from the guns, directly at Sol, and they light up the entire Watchtower.
units.displayText: Dazzling white beams spray from the guns, directly at Sol, and they light up the entire Watchtower.

spans.text: Dazzling white beams spray from the guns, directly at Sol, and they light up the entire Watchtower.

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: A deafening explosion fills the air.
units.displayText: A deafening explosion fills the air.

spans.text: A deafening explosion fills the air.

units.rawText: The ground shakes violently. Dirt and rock fly in all directions and the air is filled with clouds of dust.
units.displayText: The ground shakes violently. Dirt and rock fly in all directions and the air is filled with clouds of dust.

spans.text: The ground shakes violently. Dirt and rock fly in all directions and the air is filled with clouds of dust.

units.rawText: (Coughs) Whew... Did we do it?
units.displayText: (Coughs) Whew... Did we do it?

spans.text: (Coughs) Whew... Did we do it?

units.rawText: The dust settles, revealing the mess that is the interior of the Watchtower. The black-clad girl stands, still holding her sword.
units.displayText: The dust settles, revealing the mess that is the interior of the Watchtower. The black-clad girl stands, still holding her sword.

spans.text: The dust settles, revealing the mess that is the interior of the Watchtower. The black-clad girl stands, still holding her sword.

units.rawText: Blood is dripping from the corner of her mouth, but she wipes it away like it was nothing, swinging her sword like she doesn't feel the pain at all.
units.displayText: Blood is dripping from the corner of her mouth, but she wipes it away like it was nothing, swinging her sword like she doesn't feel the pain at all.

spans.text: Blood is dripping from the corner of her mouth, but she wipes it away like it was nothing, swinging her sword like she doesn't feel the pain at all.

units.rawText: You think you can bring down a warrior with only this much force?
units.displayText: You think you can bring down a warrior with only this much force?

spans.text: You think you can bring down a warrior with only this much force?

units.rawText: Flames roil and heat the air, a sign that Sol's will still burns.
units.displayText: Flames roil and heat the air, a sign that Sol's will still burns.

spans.text: Flames roil and heat the air, a sign that Sol's will still burns.

units.rawText: In that case...
units.displayText: In that case...

spans.text: In that case...

units.rawText: <size=40>I'll break that illusion of yours with my own hands!</size>
units.displayText: I'll break that illusion of yours with my own hands!

spans.text: I'll break that illusion of yours with my own hands!

units.rawText: Middle Ring, Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: Middle Ring, Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: Middle Ring, Tartarus Sector.
